findings.note: Says Minnesota runs the ball at one of the NFL's highest rates, RB Jordan Mason is back at practice, and the Colts allow 4.7 yards per carry; both writers pick a lopsided Vikings win (26-10, 27-13), which suggests fewer late passes.
CBS Sports picks Vikings -6.5 and projects a 33-19 Minnesota win. If the Vikings lead comfortably, they will likely run more, which works against a high passing-attempt total for Murray.

ESPN's Solak says Murray will have Jefferson, Addison and Hockenson all healthy, and predicts Minnesota leads the league in scoring. Bowen notes Murray has 16 rushing attempts over his last two games, and those scrambles and runs can take away from his pass attempts.
